narr: An outflow boundary from a decaying MCS triggered isolated strong to severe thunderstorms during the afternoon and evening hours on May 9th. Due to the slow movement of the storms, some localized flooding also occurred.
ev: Several homes flooded at the Links Golf Club course near Cypress Creek.
lsr: REPORT OF FLOODING AT THE LINKS IN TUSCALOOSA. TIME ESTIMATED.
